sectionPlanTemplate.guidance: Draft every visible section from a claim, reader question, evidence need, and usefulness reason before writing final copy.

sections.sectionClaim: A skin scan is most useful as a quick, private starting point for visible questions, not as a diagnosis.
sections.readerQuestion: Is an online skin analysis worth trying?
sections.evidenceNeeded: MyMirror scan capability and limitations; live competitor pattern research.
sections.exampleOrTradeoff: It can organize visible oiliness and breakouts; it cannot diagnose the cause of a painful rash.
sections.caveatOrNotRightForYou: Readers seeking a diagnosis, urgent treatment, or prescription advice should contact a dermatologist.
sections.decisionPurpose: Set an honest expectation before CTA.
sections.transitionPurpose: Move from promise to what happens in the scan.

sections.sectionClaim: Readers trust a scan more when they know the simple journey from face view to prioritized next step.
sections.readerQuestion: What will happen after I start?
sections.evidenceNeeded: MyMirror homepage workflow and product patterns.
sections.exampleOrTradeoff: A region-by-region view makes an oily T-zone easier to separate from marks on the cheeks.
sections.caveatOrNotRightForYou: Lighting and what is visible on the day can affect what a camera can interpret.
sections.decisionPurpose: Remove signup, privacy, and process uncertainty.
sections.transitionPurpose: Move from mechanics to useful decisions.

sections.sectionClaim: The value is choosing where to begin, not receiving a beauty score.
sections.readerQuestion: How would this change what I do next?
sections.evidenceNeeded: Audience research and MyMirror product positioning.
sections.exampleOrTradeoff: A reader with several concerns can start with the most visible priority instead of layering three new actives.
sections.caveatOrNotRightForYou: A scan should not be used to decide whether a serious symptom needs medical attention.
sections.decisionPurpose: Make the CTA commercially relevant without overselling.

sections.sectionClaim: Clear boundaries make a scan more useful, not less useful.
sections.readerQuestion: What can a face scan not tell me?
sections.evidenceNeeded: Responsible competitor disclaimers and MyMirror non-diagnosis policy.
sections.exampleOrTradeoff: A normal-looking image cannot rule out a condition; a changing or painful concern deserves professional advice.
sections.caveatOrNotRightForYou: Do not rely on a scan for urgent or persistent symptoms.
sections.decisionPurpose: Protect reader trust and satisfy the health sensitivity requirement.
sections.transitionPurpose: Prepare a human closing and CTA.

sections.sectionClaim: One clear view is a better first step than more guessing.
sections.exampleOrTradeoff: Start now if you want help prioritizing visible signals; choose a dermatologist if you need medical assessment.
sections.caveatOrNotRightForYou: No promise of diagnosis, cure, or permanent change.
